error_analysis.finding: Fine-tuning eliminated format and function-selection errors (JSON validity 99.4%, name accuracy 98.4%). Residual 21% error is 90% argument-level: wrong values (unknown API enum codes, e.g. category '4093' vs '6017', 'uk' vs ISO 'gb') and wrong/missing keys. Type-coercion artifacts are negligible (+0.2%), so strict exact-match is a faithful metric.
